_comment: Deterministic render settings for the plugin safety harness. mock.json is a real ESPN snapshot (2026 season) plus synthetic practice/poles/latest-round seeds, so every screen renders offline with no network. freeze_time (2026-06-16) sits two days after the most recent completed race, Barcelona-Catalunya (round 7, 2026-06-14); race results are seeded through round 9 and qualifying/sprint plus the latest-round value are keyed to round 9 (Silverstone) so the recent-races, qualifying and sprint screens still have data to render -- these are rendering seeds, not a claim that those later rounds have run by the frozen date. No session window is open at the frozen time, so no live badge appears. sizes exercises the adaptive font-grid snapping and vertical centering across 64x32 and 128x32 (narrow/short), 256x32 (wide/short), 192x48 (the wide-short rig), and the two tall panels 128x64 and 256x64. Golden images exist only for f1_upcoming: it renders a full static frame, whereas the seven scroll modes (standings/results/qualifying/practice/sprint/calendar) start with a blank scroll-in buffer so a single-frame capture is empty and not worth committing. Those modes are still covered by this harness's crash + overflow checks at every size; missing goldens are skipped, not failed.
